steps.en: Install the CLI on an Apple-Silicon Mac and let it fetch Xcode/SDK prerequisites
steps.zh: 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上装 CLI，补齐 Xcode 等前置

steps.en: Start the relay and the agent together on that Mac
steps.zh: 在这台 Mac 上一起启动 relay 和 agent

steps.en: Serve the dashboard on port 4000; the agent dials out and registers every simulator and emulator
steps.zh: 在 4000 端口提供看板；agent 主动连出，登记所有模拟器

steps.en: Create the admin, upload a .app.zip or .apk in App Center, press Start QA
steps.zh: 建管理员，上传 .app.zip／.apk，点 Start QA

steps.en: Boot the picked device on demand, install the build, stream H.264 to the browser
steps.zh: 按需启动选中的设备，装好构建，把 H.264 画面推到浏览器

steps.en: Send an invite link; the teammate clicks and drags on the screen in any browser
steps.zh: 发邀请链接；队友在任意浏览器里对着屏幕点击、拖动

steps.en: Forward each click and drag to the simulator as a real tap or swipe
steps.zh: 把每次点击、拖动转成模拟器上真实的点按和滑动

value.en: PMs, designers and backend devs test the latest build from a browser — no Xcode on their laptop, no build uploaded to a third-party device cloud.
value.zh: 产品、设计、后端在浏览器里就能测最新构建——自己电脑不装 Xcode，构建也不必上传到第三方设备云。
